notes.title: Obsession - New Features and Enhancements!
notes.notes:
Dear players,

We continue to improve Obsession to make your gaming experience even more immersive. In this update, we have added:

🔹 Dialogue choices – your decisions now have an even greater impact on the story.
🔹 Puzzles – new challenges to test your logic and attention to detail.
🔹 Global color correction – all locations now look more atmospheric and enhance the world’s mood.
🔹 Visual improvements – enhanced details, updated textures, and new effects for a more immersive experience.
🔹 Bug fixes – improved stability and eliminated errors to ensure a smoother gameplay experience.
🔹 Additional non-playable objects – the world feels more alive with new environmental details.

Thank you for being with us! We value your feedback and will continue to make Obsession even better for you.

— The Spektor Team
